the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Write U = Spec(k); for a field extension k'/k with U' = Spec(k') and R' the restriction of R, set Z' = Z times_R R' and W' = R' times_R W. For a point xi = (z, w) of Z times_{s, U, t} W with r the image of z in R, the explain-points lemma provides k' and r' in R' over r; one can choose z' in Z' mapping to z and r', and then a point xi' of Z' times_{s', U', t'} W' mapping to z' and xi. The open c(r', W') of R' (move-point lemma) is contained in the image of Z' times_{s', U', t'} W' to R'; the displayed identification of Z' times W' with the base change of Z times_{s, U, t} W along R' times R' inside R times R shows the image of Z' times W' to R' to R lands in the image of Z times_{s, U, t} W to R; and R' to R is open (restrict-groupoid-on-field lemma). Hence the image of Z times_{s, U, t} W to R contains an open neighbourhood of the image of each xi, i.e. it is open. (source lines 1416-1436)
